name: MDPHP
summary: MDPHP aka 'Monkey-Dust' is a substituted cathinone and pyrovalerone which has often been sold as an alternative to a-PHP and MDPV. The drug is reported to be less intense than MDPV while having similar subjective effects. MDPHP potency is reported to vary wildly, and there are reports of mixed composition batches containing other drugs. There is little known about MDPHP in terms of toxicity, pharmacology, and metabolism.
advisory: The dosage data is tentative. Potency and composition of batches vary significantly and as such caution should be used when taking MDPHP. See ~mdphp summary

pharmacology.text: MDPHP acts as a potent norepinephrine-dopamine reuptake inhibitor. The IC50 values for MDPHP are 60-935 nM at NET, 8.4-50 nM at DAT and 9000 nM at SERT.

uses.text: MDPHP (3',4'-Methylenedioxy-α-pyrrolidinohexiophenone) is a stimulant of the cathinone class originally developed in the 1960s, which has been reported as a novel designer drug. It is closely related to the potent stimulant MDPV though with slightly milder effects, and has been used as an alternative in some countries following the banning of MDPV.

summaryZh: MDPHP，化學名：1-[3,4-(亞甲二氧基)苯基]-2-(N-吡咯烷基)-1-己酮是一種含氮有機化合物，化學式C17H23NO3，屬於卡西酮衍生物，與MDPV、MDPEP是同系物，1960年代首次合成，2018年列入《非藥用類麻醉藥品和精神藥品名錄》。
summaryZhHans: MDPHP，化学名：1-[3,4-(亚甲二氧基)苯基]-2-(N-吡咯烷基)-1-己酮是一种含氮有机化合物，化学式C17H23NO3，属于卡西酮衍生物，与MDPV、MDPEP是同系物，1960年代首次合成，2018年列入《非药用类麻醉药品和精神药品名录》。

sideEffects.en: It can cause a racing heart, high blood pressure, overheating, agitation, paranoia, psychosis and strong urges to redose. Severe cases involve violent agitation and dangerous overheating, and related drugs have been linked to deaths.
sideEffects.zh: 它可能引起心跳過快、高血壓、體溫過高、躁動、偏執、精神病與強烈的追加使用衝動。嚴重時會出現激烈躁動與危險的高體溫，相關藥物也曾與死亡案例有關。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它可能引起心跳过快、高血压、体温过高、躁动、偏执、精神病与强烈的追加使用冲动。严重时会出现激烈躁动与危险的高体温，相关药物也曾与死亡案例有关。

fact.en: MDPHP was first made in the 1960s, and decades later it became one of the main drugs sold in parts of England under the name monkey dust.
fact.zh: MDPHP 最早在1960年代被合成，幾十年後成為英格蘭部分地區以「monkey dust」（猴子粉）之名販售的主要藥物之一。
fact.zhHans: MDPHP 最早在1960年代被合成，几十年后成为英格兰部分地区以「monkey dust」（猴子粉）之名贩售的主要药物之一。
